react_native_issues.issue: Deprecation warning still fires on app load: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Non-blocking, carryover from iterations 1-3. Reference: /app/frontend/app/player.tsx or similar overlay component.

action_items: OPTIONAL: track down the remaining props.pointerEvents usage and move to style.pointerEvents to silence the RN deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend auth cleanly matches the integration playbook: passlib bcrypt + pyjwt HS256, admin hash upserted from ADMIN_PASSWORD env on startup, JWT sub='admin', OAuth2PasswordBearer(auto_error=True) so protected endpoints return 401 on missing Bearer.
Case-sensitivity is enforced on BOTH username (direct string compare against ADMIN_USERNAME) and password (bcrypt.verify) â€” verified via wrong-case tests.
Frontend api.updateSettings raises 'UNAUTHORIZED' on 401 which settings.tsx catches to auto-logout + prompt re-login (good UX).
storage.secureSet('admin_jwt', token) + verifyAdmin on mount keeps the admin session valid across returns to Settings until logout.
POST /api/settings triggers refresh_cache(force=True) then returns fresh /status/source in one round-trip â€” matches the frontend contract.
No mongodb _id leakage; all responses clean.
The date picker correctly requests /api/guide?start=<startOfDay ISO> for non-today days, so the returned window aligns to that day (no red now-line on non-today) â€” matches spec.
